name: 날렵형
prompt:
Create additional HEADLESS BODY pixel sprites for the exact original baseball player in reference. Transparent background, no heads/hair/face/caps, no words/logos or cell lines. THREE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, exactly12 bodies, evenly spaced with large gutters. Each column is one distinct right-handed batting form facing screen RIGHT, green jersey white pants green socks dark shoes brown bat, normal athletic proportion and identical body size across cells. Explicit three column identities: LEFT balanced shoulder-height bat, feet moderate width; MIDDLE high vertical bat above shoulder with high front-knee leg kick; RIGHT low compact hands near back hip and small controlled stride. Row1: each form's READY stance. Row2: each form's LOAD and stride, distinctly different high knee only middle. Row3: ball CONTACT with both hands holding bat pointing right approximately horizontal, weight on front leg. Row4: natural FOLLOW THROUGH, arms crossing up toward the left shoulder, bat points UP LEFT after rotation. Normal realistic baseball kinetic sequence simplified to chunky readable game pixels. Body includes only torso, two arms, neck stump and two legs. Neck stump is a clear anchor and same thickness as reference. DO NOT add a head even in ready or finish poses. Match reference normal body proportions, flat abdomen and modest shoulders, not huge muscles. Hands firmly surround one bat handle, two arms/two legs, no extra limbs. Square pixel steps and simple clusters, limited shades, no smooth lineart or watercolor. All feet share a baseline within each row; each cell same body scale, no enlargement of squatted forms.
PHYSIQUE VARIANT EDIT: Keep the first reference's exact pose grid, cell count, animation order, camera angle, uniform, bat where present, and transparent background. Replace every normal body with the second reference's physique: slender narrow shoulders, narrow torso, slim arms and legs, slightly taller than normal. Same body scale and consistent proportions through every pose. No head or face. Preserve hands, shoes and neck anchor. Do not add round belly or childlike proportions.

name: 중량형
prompt:
Make an original baseball game animation BODY atlas matching the reference normal athletic green-uniform player exactly. NO head, hair, face, cap, text, lettering or logos. Transparent background, six columns x three rows, exactly EIGHTEEN separated HEADLESS bodies. Keep one consistent size, sleeve/pants/socks/shoes design, clear neck socket and crisp chunky square pixel clusters. Each COLUMN is one body-language personality routine, with three phases top-to-bottom. Column1 energetic: crouch loading both fists, airborne jump both arms up, land knees bent fists forward. Column2 reserved: standing hands politely clasped in front waist, right hand touches where brim would be above neck, hands together again. Column3 boastful: hands on hips proud chest, forearms crossed at chest, forearms crossed leaning back slightly. Column4 easygoing: neutral upright arms down (IMPORTANT true standing calibration pose), right hand covering where mouth would be above neck with relaxed shoulder as yawning, both hands behind where head would be stretching. Column5 oddball: one hand behind hip torso leaning one side, right arm points UP-RIGHT, one hand behind hip leaning other side. Column6 grumbling: forearms crossed, one knee lifted while arms still crossed like stamping a foot, crouched compact arms crossed. No actual head even when hands touch hypothetical face. Preserve athlete neck/torso/limb proportions, not baby bodies or obesity. Hands stay anatomically attached, no extra fingers/limbs. Frame camera is FRONT or slight front-right for all; no literal face expressions. Each non-jumping pose feet on its cell baseline; jumping sprite lifted 1-2 logical pixels only. Three phases must read as small character habits independent of running speed or ability. Flat colors and readable large pixel shapes, not fuzzy vector illustration.
PHYSIQUE VARIANT EDIT: Keep the first reference's exact pose grid, cell count, animation order, camera angle, uniform, bat where present, and transparent background. Replace every normal body with the second reference's physique: heavy muscular solid broad chest, thick arms/thighs, flat abdomen and substantial waist; not round or obese. Same body scale and consistent proportions through every pose. No head or face. Preserve hands, shoes and neck anchor. Do not add round belly or childlike proportions.
